# Keyboard shortcuts

In this guide, `Ctrl / Cmd` means `Ctrl` on Windows and Linux, and `⌘` (Command) on macOS. `Alt` means Option on macOS. The macOS column shows the same shortcuts in macOS notation, for example `⇧⌘Z`. The shortcut help (`?` or `F1`) shows each shortcut in your platform's notation.

Most shortcuts work only in the region they belong to, such as the viewport or the timeline. Press `F6` to move focus between regions. Shortcuts that work everywhere are listed first.

> [!NOTE]
> Single-key shortcuts such as `R`, `V` and `M` work only while their region has focus, and are marked "Single key" below. Turn them off with the **Single-key shortcuts** setting if they get in the way. Shortcuts do not fire while you type in a text field, except `Ctrl / Cmd+K`, `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+P`, `F1`, `Ctrl / Cmd+S` and `Esc`.

## Everywhere

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |
| ------ | ---- | ----- | ----- |
| Command palette | `Ctrl / Cmd+K` or `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+P` | `⌘K` or `⇧⌘P` | Works in text fields |
| Keyboard shortcuts | `?` or `F1` | `?` or `F1` | Single key; Works in text fields |
| Undo | `Ctrl / Cmd+Z` | `⌘Z` |  |
| Redo | `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+Z` or `Ctrl / Cmd+Y` | `⇧⌘Z` or `⌘Y` |  |
| Save project | `Ctrl / Cmd+S` | `⌘S` | Works in text fields |
| Download project file | `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+S` | `⇧⌘S` |  |
| Open project file | `Ctrl / Cmd+O` | `⌘O` |  |
| New character | `Ctrl / Cmd+Alt+N` | `⌥⌘N` |  |
| Switch workspace | `Ctrl / Cmd+Alt+P` | `⌥⌘P` |  |
| Export | `Ctrl / Cmd+E` | `⌘E` |  |
| Focus next region | `F6` | `F6` |  |
| Focus previous region | `Shift+F6` | `⇧F6` |  |
| Toggle dock | `Ctrl / Cmd+J` | `⌘J` |  |
| Show timeline | `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+L` | `⇧⌘L` |  |
| Show material graph | `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+G` | `⇧⌘G` |  |
| Show post-process graph | `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+O` | `⇧⌘O` |  |
| Maximize dock | `Ctrl / Cmd+Shift+M` | `⇧⌘M` |  |
| Inspector: Parts | `Alt+Shift+1` | `⌥⇧1` |  |
| Inspector: Colors | `Alt+Shift+2` | `⌥⇧2` |  |
| Inspector: Anatomy | `Alt+Shift+3` | `⌥⇧3` |  |
| Inspector: Render | `Alt+Shift+4` | `⌥⇧4` |  |
| Inspector: Animation | `Alt+Shift+5` | `⌥⇧5` |  |

The inspector tabs are numbered in this order: 1 Parts, 2 Colors, 3 Anatomy, 4 Render, 5 Animation.

## Wizard

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |
| ------ | ---- | ----- | ----- |
| Exit wizard | `Esc` | `Esc` | Works in text fields |

## Home screen and Easy workspace

These belong to the controls themselves, not to the shortcut registry. They work when the control has focus.

| Action | Keys |
| ------ | ---- |
| Move through the avatar strip on the home screen | Left and Right arrows; Home and End for the first and last character |
| Run the main action for the selected character (Edit or Start from this preset) | Enter, with the avatar strip focused |
| Turn the Easy preview one 45-degree step | Left and Right arrows, with the preview focused |
| Move between tiles | Arrow keys; Home and End for the first and last tile |
| Choose a tile | Enter or Space |
| Move through a color swatch row, checking each swatch | Arrow keys |

## Part library

These work while the part library has focus.

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |
| ------ | ---- | ----- | ----- |
| Randomize | `R` | `R` | Single key |
| Randomize again | `Shift+R` | `⇧R` | Single key |
| Clear slot | `Delete` or `Backspace` | `⌦` or `⌫` | With a slot in the part library focused |

## Inspector

These work while the inspector has focus.

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |
| ------ | ---- | ----- | ----- |
| Randomize | `R` | `R` | Single key |
| Randomize again | `Shift+R` | `⇧R` | Single key |

## Timeline

These work while the timeline has focus.

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |

## Shader graph canvas

These arrive with the shader graph editor in a later release. They work while the graph canvas has focus.

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |
| ------ | ---- | ----- | ----- |
| Add node (search) | `Shift+A` or `Space` | `⇧A` or `Space` | Single key; A quick tap, not a hold |
| Graph zoom in | `+` | `+` | Single key |
| Graph zoom out | `-` | `-` | Single key |
| Mute node | `M` | `M` | Single key |
| Hide unused sockets | `Alt+Shift+H` | `⌥⇧H` |  |
| Frame selection | `F` | `F` | Single key |
| Frame all | `Home` | `Home` |  |
| Frame box | `J` | `J` | Single key |
| Enter or exit group | `Tab` | `Tab` | Enters a selected group; leaves a group when nothing is selected inside it |
| Exit group | `Esc` | `Esc` | Inside a group, with nothing selected |
| Copy nodes | `Ctrl / Cmd+C` | `⌘C` |  |
| Cut nodes | `Ctrl / Cmd+X` | `⌘X` |  |
| Paste nodes | `Ctrl / Cmd+V` | `⌘V` |  |
| Duplicate nodes | `Ctrl / Cmd+D` or `Shift+D` | `⌘D` or `⇧D` | Single key |
| Delete nodes | `Delete` or `Backspace` | `⌦` or `⌫` |  |
| Select all nodes | `A` or `Ctrl / Cmd+A` | `A` or `⌘A` | Single key |
| Deselect all nodes | `Alt+A` | `⌥A` |  |
| Group nodes | `Ctrl / Cmd+G` | `⌘G` |  |
| Ungroup nodes | `Ctrl / Cmd+Alt+G` | `⌥⌘G` |  |
| Toggle node preview | `Shift+H` | `⇧H` | Single key |
| Collapse node | `H` | `H` | Single key |
| Nudge nodes | `Ctrl / Cmd+←` or `Ctrl / Cmd+→` or `Ctrl / Cmd+↑` or `Ctrl / Cmd+↓` | `⌘←` or `⌘→` or `⌘↑` or `⌘↓` |  |
| Connect socket | `C` | `C` | Single key; With a socket focused |
| Toggle snapping | `Shift+S` | `⇧S` | Single key |
| Align left | `Alt+Shift+←` | `⌥⇧←` |  |
| Align right | `Alt+Shift+→` | `⌥⇧→` |  |
| Align top | `Alt+Shift+↑` | `⌥⇧↑` |  |
| Align bottom | `Alt+Shift+↓` | `⌥⇧↓` |  |
| Find node | `Ctrl / Cmd+F` | `⌘F` |  |
| Open context menu | `Shift+F10` or `ContextMenu` | `⇧F10` or `ContextMenu` |  |

In any other case, `Tab` moves focus as usual, so you can always leave the canvas with `Tab` or `F6`.

Move focus between nodes with the arrow keys. Press `Enter` to enter the focused node, and `Tab` or `Shift+Tab` to move between its sockets and controls. Press `Escape` to leave the node.

Mouse gestures on the canvas: hold `Space` and drag, or drag with the middle button, to pan (a quick tap of `Space` opens the node search instead). Zoom with `Ctrl / Cmd` and the mouse wheel. Hold `Alt` while dragging a node to place it without snapping.

## Fitting a prop

These arrive with prop fitting in the upload wizard, in a later release.

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |
| ------ | ---- | ----- | ----- |
| Fitting: move | `W` | `W` | Single key |
| Fitting: rotate | `E` | `E` | Single key |
| Fitting: scale | `R` | `R` | Single key; Replaces "Randomize" |
| Fitting: confirm | `Enter` | `Enter` |  |
| Fitting: cancel | `Esc` | `Esc` |  |

## Dialogs and overlays

| Action | Keys | macOS | Notes |
| ------ | ---- | ----- | ----- |
| Close dialog | `Esc` | `Esc` | Works in text fields |

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Some shortcuts replace browser shortcuts while the editor is focused. These include `Ctrl / Cmd+E`, `Ctrl / Cmd+J`, `Ctrl / Cmd+D`, `Ctrl / Cmd+G` and `Ctrl / Cmd+O`. The editor never uses reserved browser shortcuts such as `Ctrl+T`, `Ctrl+W`, `Ctrl+R`, `Ctrl+N` or browser zoom.
